events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "logForm" app/src cloud/src cloud/funnel 2>/dev/null | head; ls app/src/app | head -60; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone tantra-frontend-v2 adi-new-ui into home dir
events.input: $ cd /tmp && rm -rf tfv2 && gh repo clone Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 tfv2 -- -b adi-new-ui -q 2>&1 | tail -3; cd tfv2 && git log --oneline -3 && ls src/lib/billing/ && cd /tmp && shopt -s dotglob 2>/dev/null; setopt glob_dots 2>/dev/null; mv /tmp/tfv2/* ~/tantra-frontend-v2/ && cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && git status -sb | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pricing constants and Calendly usages
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2; wc -l src/lib/billing/pricing.ts; grep -nE "export const|CALENDLY|ENTERPRISE" src/lib/billing/pricing.ts | head -60; grep -rn "ENTERPRISE_CALENDLY_URL" src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v "pricing.ts" | head
